option_relations.rationale: The option directly matches the label of leaf B1.1, Chronic Frontal Sinusitis with Cutaneous Fistula.
Chronic sinusitis with cutaneous fistula is a broader term that encompasses the specific conditions described by leaves B1.1, B1.2, and B1.3.
Chronic sinusitis with mucocele/pyocele and cutaneous fistula is a specific type of chronic sinusitis, making option C a subtype of the conditions related to leaf B1.2.
The option directly matches the label of leaf B1.3, Pott's Puffy Tumor with Sinocutaneous Fistula Secondary to Chronic Sinusitis.
